answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the pulse until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nebula of the next round. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short.
